title: Your 'Run idea / feedback past Steve' idea: who opens the review page, an Admin for now or Steve with his own sign-in?
bluf: Tap a to build it with an Admin approving for now. Your idea: a new first choice 'Run idea / feedback past Steve', and a page where those items are approved (then sent on to Jira) or deleted. The catch: the review site has no named people, only four shared sign-in levels, so it cannot tell who Steve is, and Steve has no sign-in that I can find. Items with the new choice would be held back and never sent until approved. Also say if Delete should hide an item and keep its text, instead of removing the text for good.

options.label: Admin opens the page for now
options.detail: Held items are approved or deleted by an Admin (Steve can sit beside you). Delete removes the text for good and keeps a log line. Roughly 17 files and a database change, by a count of the code it touches, not a measured build; no new accounts. Then a strict check before anything lands; not deployed.

options.label: Steve gets his own Reviewer sign-in
options.detail: The same page, opened by Steve himself. Roughly 20 files, plus an HP account for him that does not exist yet, so it cannot work on the review site until he has a real sign-in.

options.label: Park it as a next-phase note
options.detail: Nothing is built now; the idea is written down for later.

default_action: If you never answer, c: nothing is built. Adding only the new choice would promise a review nobody performs, because once sending is switched on those items would go to Jira like any other.
facts: Your note, verbatim (review site feedback, 2 Nov 23:14 UTC, page /home): 'Add as the first item in feedback What is it about - "Run idea / feedback past Steve" add a new page that allows Steve to navigate to a feedback with all these submissions (the ones with his name) and approve or delete.  Once approved, they get submitted to Jira - Kam'.

Steve is read as Steve Inch of HP: your notes of the 29 September HP meeting (C-30), and the 16 October card about 'Steve's DBS forward' carrying two HP PDFs. The note gives no surname, so this is a reading, not confirmed.
A feedback item stores a user id and a role, not a name; 'the ones with his name' can only mean items with the new choice.

Sending to Jira is off on the review site today: its three items each record delivery 'off', still pending, 0 attempts, no Jira issue (read 3 Nov). So an approved item there shows 'saved, not sent' until sending is switched on.
_override_prior: Plain add refused just before this post, matches shown: hpsmpoc-steve-dbs-pdfs-cleared-for-ai-1016 (read by show: whether two HP PDFs Steve forwarded may be read by AI seats; a different subject, cited here only as evidence of who Steve is); the other four share only 'page' (frame names, UAT start page words, the focus-ring page nudge; titles read). This asks how to build his own 2 Nov feedback item, which no card has covered.
